packet.comment: An NPC leaves the map by a warp, on its way to another. The client takes it off the map as it goes, rather than as a death: no health bar, no sound, no drop. It has just stepped onto the warp, so the client can let that step finish first. Sent to the players in range of the warp.

An NPC strikes another NPC: a resident one of the monsters it hunts, or a monster a resident that struck it. The attacker turns to face its target and swings, and the target takes the damage, shown on its health bar. Sent to the players in range of the target.

field.name: direction
field.comment: The way it faces to strike

field.name: hp_percentage
field.comment: What is left of the target's HP, as a percentage

field.name: killed
field.comment: Whether the strike killed the target: the client takes it off the map as a death. Nothing drops, and no player gains experience. A resident struck down this way is carried home, and appears there again

packet.comment: An NPC uses an item on itself, as a hurt resident drinks a potion while it hunts. It heals, and the client shows the heal on its health bar. Sent to the players in range of the NPC.

field.name: hp_percentage
field.comment: Its HP after, as a percentage
